items.text: Under the current design, a store can never have more than one exclusion period recorded, and no two rows can share the same begin or end date.

This table holds only 2 rows, entered years apart by two different people and never updated since: store 0154 excluded from 2017-06-08 to 2017-07-12 (remodeling following an incident) and store 0191 excluded from 2019-11-24 to 2019-12-25 (a fire closure). There is no staging table or ongoing process feeding this table; it is entered by hand.
The store reference and the two exclusion dates each point to the store and date reference tables correctly.

blocks.text: Still open, not confirmed in code or data yet. None of this blocks the lineage above, it is tracked here so nothing gets forgotten.

items.text: Whether it is intentional that a store can only ever have one exclusion period recorded has not been confirmed
items.note: If a store ever needed a second extended closure, the current design would not support it without a change, so this should be confirmed before carrying the same limitation into the target platform
